entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Oh, hey guys... good job.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hm? Jose-chan, you seem kinda down.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is something wrong?

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to make you worry...

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: But a lot's happened lately.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Before I got here, I was able to drink [n]so many flowers.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: That was all thanks to you guys.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: So, I thought I was beginning to[n]understand humans...

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: But now, the more flowers I drink, [n]the less I understand them instead.
How does that work?
What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ohhh, I gotcha. It's like love, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know, puppy love?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You understand his explanation? Skull...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You know squat about love.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Shut up! I know what I'm talkin' about![n]Pretty much!

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Boneface is right. I've learned about[n]humans in a manner similar to falling[n]in love.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: When you learn more about a subject, it's[n]often more than unexpected—it's the exact[n]opposite of what you liked about it.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Just like with love.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: R-Right!? ...See!?

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: I want to learn more about humans...

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: But I wonder if I'll learn what I need to[n]about them just by keeping at it like[n]this...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Mind if I propose a simple solution?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Why study humans at all? Why not[n]just give it up?

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: I can't do that.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: I promised someone that I'd study[n]humans.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Who'd you promise?

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Sorry. Forget I said that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can see how that would worry you...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There are times where the truth seems[n]to move further away from you, the[n]more you strive to reach it.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I've dealt with similar problems, so[n]I can totally relate.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I aim to handle them whenever the[n]opportunity presents itself, though.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: I really appreciate your help with this.[n]So, I need an opportunity...

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Oh, that's it!

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Could I ask you guys a favor?

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: I'd like you to fight me.
Fight you?
Why?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Uh, yeah, I think you left out a step or[n]three. I'm not following here.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: I've learned something from studying[n]humans...

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: When humans suffer, they vent their[n]emotions so they can move forward[n]with their lives.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Well, right now, I'm suffering.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: The only people I can vent at are[n]you guys...

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: And the most common way to vent...[n]is to fight.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You wanna get physical here!?[n]You can't just fight pick a fight[n]with us outta nowhere!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What do we do? I definitely didn't[n]expect this...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, unless we fight him, we won't know[n]whether or not this is his "opportunity."

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We simply have to decide if we're going[n]to humor him.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What do you think? Should we fight Jose?
Hang on.
Let's fight.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Oh, too bad...

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Let me know if you ever change your[n]mind.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: I stop here from time to time, so swing[n]by if you're in the area.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Well, see you later. Good job.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Thanks.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: This may be sudden, but—here I come!
